## [1.2.0-dev.2](https://gitlab.com/LOCKhart07/morphe-patches/compare/v1.2.0-dev.1...v1.2.0-dev.2) (2026-10-21)

### ✨ New Features

* Heads Up! – split hide empty custom decks into its own patch ([652cd79](https://gitlab.com/LOCKhart07/morphe-patches/commit/652cd79a2979c23029ecbf2080b2b8cdd8f28289))

patches.name: Hide empty custom decks
patches.description: Shows one empty custom deck in My Decks instead of all of them. A new one appears after you restart the app.

patches.name: Round length
patches.description: Adds an option to change the round length from the deck page.

patches.name: Sort decks alphabetically
patches.description: Sorts My Decks alphabetically instead of by recent purchases and plays.

patches.name: Unlock all decks
patches.description: Unlocks every deck without a purchase.
